claims.text: Utopia is on Elia Beach, on the south coast of Mykonos.

findings.quote: Located on Elia Beach, on the island’s glorious south coast, Utopia is an escape into luxury and island magic.

claims.text: Elia Beach is the longest sandy beach on Mykonos and is known for its clear waters.

findings.quote: Elia Beach, the longest sandy beach on Mykonos, is celebrated for its crystal-clear waters and relaxed, unhurried atmosphere.

claims.text: Guests have a dedicated area of Elia Beach with sunbeds, umbrellas, beach towels and a bar.

findings.quote: For Utopia guests, a dedicated area of the beach offers seamless access to the shoreline.
with comfortable sunbeds and umbrellas, fresh beach towels, and a bar serving chilled drinks, fresh smoothies and light snacks

claims.text: After dark, lighting makes the pool sparkle and the pool terrace becomes a nightlife spot.

findings.quote: After dark, the pool terrace transforms into a nightlife hotspot, with artful lighting design making the pool sparkle as if filled with stars

claims.text: Grand Majestic Retreat suites blend designer pieces with traditional craftsmanship and natural textures.

findings.quote: a delightfully modern aesthetic that blends designer pieces with traditional craftsmanship and luxurious natural textures

claims.text: Heavenly Retreat rooms have rain showers, warm wood and carved stone accents, and a furnished balcony or a terrace with hot tub.

findings.quote: these superior guest rooms feature luxe rain showers and exquisite accents in warm wood and carved stone, and come with your choice of furnished private balcony or private terrace with hot tub

claims.text: Signature Retreat rooms come with a furnished private balcony or a furnished terrace with private pool.

findings.quote: Signature Retreat guest rooms are available with your choice of furnished private balcony or furnished terrace with private pool.

claims.text: The spa offers massages, thalassotherapy rituals and facials.

findings.quote: Indulge in a selection of pampering spa treatments, thalassotherapy rituals, soothing massages, and revitalizing facials at our luxury Mykonos spa.

claims.text: Wellness options include yoga, Pilates, personal training and a gym.

findings.quote: Discover a selection of wellness and fitness activities including yoga, Pilates, personal training, and sessions at our gym.

claims.text: Yacht day trips can sail to Delos for a private tour of its UNESCO World Heritage Site.

findings.quote: Sail to Delos for a private tour of its extraordinary UNESCO World Heritage Site

claims.text: Helicopter tours fly over Mykonos toward Delos and out over Naxos, Paros and Tinos.

findings.quote: Soar above Mykonos and enjoy a bird’s eye view of the island with a helicopter tour.
From Mykonos, fly west towards the sacred island of Delos and then out over the open sea to enjoy a unique and exclusive perspective of the Cycladic islands of Naxos, Paros, and Tinos.

claims.text: Pavilion is the hotel's Relais & Chateaux restaurant, serving creative Greek cuisine with sea views.

findings.quote: indulge in some of the best fine dining Mykonos has to offer at Pavilion, our Relais & Châteaux restaurant in Elia Beach
Savour Utopia’s creative twist on authentic Greek cuisine, paired with Pavilion’s extensive selection of Greek and international vintages and spectacular sea views.

claims.text: Utopia is perched on the hillside above the golden sands of Elia Beach.

findings.quote: Perched on the hillside above the famed golden sands of Elia Beach

claims.text: The Grand Majestic Villa has a private terrace with an infinity pool, a hot tub and views of Elia Beach and the Aegean Sea.

findings.quote: the large, 120m2 private terrace features an infinity pool and exquisite views of Elia Beach and the Aegean Sea, as well as deluxe sunbeds, a hot tub, and a barbeque area

claims.text: Grand Majestic Retreat suites have free-standing deep soak tubs and private terraces with private pools or hot tubs and views of Elia Beach.

findings.quote: free standing deep soak tubs and open onto spacious private terraces with private pools or hot tubs and breathtaking views of Elia Beach

claims.text: The pool terrace has an infinity pool with umbrella-shaded sunbeds and the Pool Club bar.

findings.quote: Luxe umbrella-shaded sunbeds are perfect for relaxing between refreshing dips in our stunning infinity pool, and the Pool Club bar will keep you going

claims.text: The hotel offers sunset yoga sessions on the uninhabited island of Rhenia and full-moon yoga and meditation on Delos.

findings.quote: exclusive sunset sessions on the uninhabited island of Rhenia and full-moon yoga and meditation experiences on the sacred island of Delos

claims.text: Mykonos Town is about a 25-minute drive from Elia Beach.

findings.quote: Just a 25’ drive from Elia Beach, Mykonos Town

claims.text: Use of the dedicated Elia Beach area is arranged through reception and carries a charge, except for Grand Majestic Villa guests.

findings.quote: Beach arrangements are made through the reception shortly before arrival
Use of this exclusive beach area is available at a nominal charge
Guests of the Grand Majestic Villa (two- and five-bedroom) enjoy complimentary use of this service.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
